arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: By the night when it covers
translations.en.pickthall: By the night enshrouding
translations.en.yusufali: By the Night as it conceals (the light);
translations.id.indonesian: Demi malam apabila menutupi (cahaya siang),

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the day when it appears
translations.en.pickthall: And the day resplendent
translations.en.yusufali: By the Day as it appears in glory;
translations.id.indonesian: dan siang apabila terang benderang,

transliteration: Wa maa khalaqaz zakara wal unthaa

translations.en.sahih: And [by] He who created the male and female,
translations.en.pickthall: And Him Who hath created male and female,
translations.en.yusufali: By (the mystery of) the creation of male and female;-
translations.id.indonesian: dan penciptaan laki-laki dan perempuan,

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, your efforts are diverse.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! your effort is dispersed (toward divers ends).
translations.en.yusufali: Verily, (the ends) ye strive for are diverse.
translations.id.indonesian: sesungguhnya usaha kamu memang berbeda-beda.

translations.en.sahih: As for he who gives and fears Allah
translations.en.pickthall: As for him who giveth and is dutiful (toward Allah)
translations.en.yusufali: So he who gives (in charity) and fears (Allah),
translations.id.indonesian: Adapun orang yang memberikan (hartanya di jalan Allah) dan bertakwa,

translations.en.sahih: And believes in the best [reward],
translations.en.pickthall: And believeth in goodness;
translations.en.yusufali: And (in all sincerity) testifies to the best,-
translations.id.indonesian: dan membenarkan adanya pahala yang terbaik (surga),

translations.en.sahih: We will ease him toward ease.
translations.en.pickthall: Surely We will ease his way unto the state of ease.
translations.en.yusufali: We will indeed make smooth for him the path to Bliss.
translations.id.indonesian: maka Kami kelak akan menyiapkan baginya jalan yang mudah.

translations.en.sahih: But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need
translations.en.pickthall: But as for him who hoardeth and deemeth himself independent,
translations.en.yusufali: But he who is a greedy miser and thinks himself self-sufficient,
translations.id.indonesian: Dan adapun orang-orang yang bakhil dan merasa dirinya cukup,

translations.en.sahih: And denies the best [reward],
translations.en.pickthall: And disbelieveth in goodness;
translations.en.yusufali: And gives the lie to the best,-
translations.id.indonesian: serta mendustakan pahala terbaik,

translations.en.sahih: We will ease him toward difficulty.
translations.en.pickthall: Surely We will ease his way unto adversity.
translations.en.yusufali: We will indeed make smooth for him the path to Misery;
translations.id.indonesian: maka kelak Kami akan menyiapkan baginya (jalan) yang sukar.

arabic: وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
transliteration: Wa maa yughnee 'anhu maaluhooo izaa taraddaa

translations.en.sahih: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls?
translations.en.pickthall: His riches will not save him when he perisheth.
translations.en.yusufali: Nor will his wealth profit him when he falls headlong (into the Pit).
translations.id.indonesian: Dan hartanya tidak bermanfaat baginya apabila ia telah binasa.

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, [incumbent] upon Us is guidance.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! Ours it is (to give) the guidance
translations.en.yusufali: Verily We take upon Ourselves to guide,
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya kewajiban Kamilah memberi petunjuk,

transliteration: Wa inna lanaa lal Aakhirata wal oolaa

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, to Us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! unto Us belong the latter portion and the former.
translations.en.yusufali: And verily unto Us (belong) the End and the Beginning.
translations.id.indonesian: dan sesungguhnya kepunyaan Kamilah akhirat dan dunia.

translations.en.sahih: So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing.
translations.en.pickthall: Therefor have I warned you of the flaming Fire
translations.en.yusufali: Therefore do I warn you of a Fire blazing fiercely;
translations.id.indonesian: Maka, kami memperingatkan kamu dengan neraka yang menyala-nyala.

translations.en.sahih: None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one.
translations.en.pickthall: Which only the most wretched must endure,
translations.en.yusufali: None shall reach it but those most unfortunate ones
translations.id.indonesian: Tidak ada yang masuk ke dalamnya kecuali orang yang paling celaka,

translations.en.sahih: Who had denied and turned away.
translations.en.pickthall: He who denieth and turneth away.
translations.en.yusufali: Who give the lie to Truth and turn their backs.
translations.id.indonesian: yang mendustakan (kebenaran) dan berpaling (dari iman).

translations.en.sahih: But the righteous one will avoid it -
translations.en.pickthall: Far removed from it will be the righteous
translations.en.yusufali: But those most devoted to Allah shall be removed far from it,-
translations.id.indonesian: Dan kelak akan dijauhkan orang yang paling takwa dari neraka itu,

translations.en.sahih: [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself
translations.en.pickthall: Who giveth his wealth that he may grow (in goodness).
translations.en.yusufali: Those who spend their wealth for increase in self-purification,
translations.id.indonesian: yang menafkahkan hartanya (di jalan Allah) untuk membersihkannya,

arabic: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍۢ تُجْزَىٰٓ
transliteration: Wa maa li ahadin 'indahoo min ni'matin tujzaaa

translations.en.sahih: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded
translations.en.pickthall: And none hath with him any favour for reward,
translations.en.yusufali: And have in their minds no favour from anyone for which a reward is expected in return,
translations.id.indonesian: padahal tidak ada seseorangpun memberikan suatu nikmat kepadanya yang harus dibalasnya,

translations.en.sahih: But only seeking the countenance of his Lord, Most High.
translations.en.pickthall: Except as seeking (to fulfil) the purpose of his Lord Most High.
translations.en.yusufali: But only the desire to seek for the Countenance of their Lord Most High;
translations.id.indonesian: tetapi (dia memberikan itu semata-mata) karena mencari keridhaan Tuhannya yang Maha Tinggi.

translations.en.sahih: And he is going to be satisfied.
translations.en.pickthall: He verily will be content.
translations.en.yusufali: And soon will they attain (complete) satisfaction.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan kelak dia benar-benar mendapat kepuasan.
